description: A tall lacquered cabinet in dark walnut veneer, brass-cornered, with doors that ease themselves open at your approach and never quite slam. Inside: a lit rail, cedar-scented air held one degree cooler than the room, and a little brass plate reading VALET BY POLARIS. It remembers how you like to be dressed. It will lay out a look on request, and it has opinions about the ones you don't ask for.
name: Polaris Valet Wardrobe
